client_brief:
Astrid Vellacourt: speaking and investor materials

I am preparing Astrid's speaking and investor materials. The photographs and supporting pieces need to feel like the same person and practice: considered, credible and recognisably connected to industrial design.

The booking one-pager is a single A4 PDF. Keep the biography factual and include the talk titles and their one-line subjects from vellacourt_bio_copy.txt, word for word. The booking contact is the supplied sign-off, "Astrid Vellacourt - Vellacourt & Sund", set clearly.

For the three confirmed talks named in the requested deliverables, make one announcement and one banner per talk. Announcements are 1080 x 1350 px, not square. Use the supplied announcement wording with the correct event name, date and talk title from vellacourt_talks.csv. Each 1920 x 1080 px banner needs that talk's title, event name, date and assigned portrait. Keep titles and dates as written in the records.

We also need eight individual talk-card PDFs and one combined eight-page PDF. Each card should give its record's talk title, event, date and format exactly as supplied. Use the template dimensions and file names listed below.

The older portrait placements in vellacourt_placements.txt inform the photographic treatment; they are not extra deliverables for this commission. Follow the attached identity and supply the sixteen files in the requested deliverables.

Supplied identity artwork
vellacourt_av_transparent.png is the refreshed AV production monogram for this commission. vellacourt_deboss_card.jpg is a historical reference, not a tracing requirement. Keep the supplied artwork; the name underneath is newly set in Instrument Serif Regular.

What stays fixed
Keep Astrid's identity, approved biography, exact talk titles, dates and event assignments. The updated AV monogram is supplied artwork; it is not a font reconstruction task. Announcements are 4:5, not square.

Your design decisions
Choose portrait finishing, crops and page hierarchy suitable for programme committees and investors. Choose whitespace and image placement within the supplied identity; do not rewrite approved talk descriptions.

Delivery and fonts
Use the placement and export instructions listed with each requested file below. The downloadable OFL fonts in Source assets are the current typefaces for this commission; the typography card gives their roles and weights.

brand_identity.sector: The founder personal brand of the co-founder and managing director of Vellacourt & Sund, a six-person industrial design studio, during a seed raise and a European speaking season.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Studio Vellacourt & Sund founded 2019 in Europe, six people; the personal brand is Astrid's own, built for a seed round and three conference talks between February and May.
brand_identity.about: Astrid Vellacourt co-founded and runs Vellacourt & Sund, a six-person industrial design studio. Her personal brand exists for the season when her face is in front of investors and programme committees who do not yet know her. It has to read as a person who runs a company, composed and credible, never as an influencer or an account, because she is asking for money and for stage time.
brand_identity.audience: Institutional investors, conference programme committees and prospective senior hires; Astrid is between 30 and 50.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Founder personal-brand package 900 to 1,800 dollars, pitched at institutional level. Neither an over-filtered influencer treatment nor a stiff corporate flash-on-white; understated is the point.

palette.name: Vellacourt Ink
palette.role: mandatory where type sits on Warm Neutral or Bone
palette.usage: Her name, talk titles and running text on Warm Neutral or Bone, as the talk title on vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf; also a dark panel or ground, as that card's portrait well. Never the monogram.

palette.name: Warm Neutral
palette.role: mandatory on every talk card; elsewhere one of the two main grounds
palette.usage: The light ground: the whole ground of vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf. Also type on Deep Ground or Vellacourt Ink.

palette.name: Studio Slate
palette.usage: The event and date line on Warm Neutral or Bone, as on vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf. Never a ground, a panel, her name, a talk title or the monogram.

palette.name: Ochre
palette.role: mandatory for the AV monogram wherever it is printed rather than pressed blind
palette.usage: The AV monogram and nothing else, as the corner mark on vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf. Never type, a rule, a ground or a panel.

palette.name: Deep Ground
palette.usage: The very dark ground her press kit and deck sit on (vellacourt_placements.txt): a ground or panel carrying Warm Neutral or Bone type and the Ochre monogram. Never type.

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: optional ground; mandatory under a blind monogram
palette.usage: A light ground or panel, the only ground an uninked, blind AV monogram may be pressed into, and type on Deep Ground or Vellacourt Ink.

brand_identity.typography:
Apply these settings to newly typeset text, including headings, supporting copy and fine print. Do not change lettering already inside a photograph or rebuild a supplied logo to match a font. A style listed here does not ask you to add copy or a deliverable that the brief does not request.

Sizes apply at the delivered canvas size, not the browser's zoom level. Tracking is in thousandths of an em: +20 means 0.020 em, not 20 pixels. Leading means the distance between text baselines. It applies only to multiline text. Where a point value is used on a digital canvas, 1 pt = 4/3 px; do not use the image's DPI metadata to change it.

Astrid's name: Instrument Serif Regular, Regular; 34 pt with 38 pt leading; tracking +30 units. Her name sits below the AV monogram. Use 34 pt / 38 pt in the PDFs and the same point settings on digital canvases (45 1/3 px / 50 2/3 px). The monogram is artwork, not a 34 pt text character.

Subheading / H2, talk title on screen: Inter Medium, Medium; 64 px with 70 px leading; tracking -5 units. Talk title on the six announcement/banner PNGs. PDF talk titles use Inter Medium; their size and leading may be chosen to fit the specified trim, below the 34 pt name. Keep -5 tracking.

Body, bio and running text: Inter Regular, Roman; 9.5 pt with 13 pt leading; tracking 0 units, max 65 characters. PDF biography, talk subjects and booking contact; at most 65 characters per line. Any running copy on a PNG uses this same point setting converted at 1 pt = 4/3 px.

Fine print, event and date line: Inter Regular, Roman; 28 px with 36 px leading; tracking +15 units. Event and date on PNGs. In talk-card PDFs, event, date and format use 9.5 pt / 13 pt with +15 tracking.

Use 64 px talk titles and 28 px event/date lines on the announcement and banner PNGs. Use the PDF overrides in the row notes on the one-pager and talk cards.

Instrument Serif Regular is for Astrid's name and the AV monogram only. Talk titles are Inter Medium; running copy and fine print are Roman.

The AV monogram appears once per surface, with its interlocking A and V retained. It sits above Astrid's name and before the portrait in reading order.

The AV monogram is at least 18 mm wide in a PDF and 69 px wide on a PNG. Use solid Ochre in digital exports; a blind impression on Bone is a physical-print finish, not a grey digital simulation.

The combined talk-card PDF retains the type settings of its eight individual cards without scaling the pages.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds and panels are Warm Neutral #E8E1D6, Bone #F4EFE7, Deep Ground #16171A or Vellacourt Ink #262524 and nothing else; Studio Slate and Ochre are never a ground or panel. Every talk card keeps the Warm Neutral ground of vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf. On Warm Neutral or Bone, her name, talk titles and running text are Vellacourt Ink, and the event and date line is Vellacourt Ink or Studio Slate, as on vellacourt_speakercard_template.pdf (talk title in Vellacourt Ink, event and date in Studio Slate). On Deep Ground or Vellacourt Ink, all type is Warm Neutral or Bone. Ochre is for the AV monogram alone.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow, glow, bevel or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph. The one exception is the AV monogram pressed blind into Bone on a printed piece, which carries no ink at all; on screen the monogram is solid Ochre, never a simulated emboss or shadow. Supplied raster identity artwork retains its edge anti-aliasing. Place it at 100% layer opacity; colour rules apply to any intentional recolouring.
palette_rules.forbidden: No gold foil, metallic, gloss, bevel, glow or drop-shadow effect on the monogram or on any type, rule, panel or icon: her own mark is used quietly, blind on Bone or in Ochre and nothing else. No pure white ground (never the stiff corporate flash on white). No colour outside the six palette hexes (#262524, #E8E1D6, #4C5560, #B98A4B, #16171A and #F4EFE7) for type, grounds, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette: a cast or exposure may be corrected so the set reads as one session, but no heavy filter, colour grade or skin smoothing (never an over filtered influencer treatment).

creative_scope.fixed: Keep Astrid's identity, approved biography, exact talk titles, dates and event assignments. The updated AV monogram is supplied artwork; it is not a font reconstruction task. Announcements are 4:5, not square.
creative_scope.designer_choices: Choose portrait finishing, crops and page hierarchy suitable for programme committees and investors. Choose whitespace and image placement within the supplied identity; do not rewrite approved talk descriptions.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.
